posts.text: US Stocks: Are We Buying the Hype Without Checking the Safety? — Several Stockal investors have reportedly alleged that their US shares were sold without authorisation, with losses exceeding ₹100 crore. Stockal is SEBI-registered and partnered with HDFC Securities in 2019 to launch GlobalInvesting.in. That operational partnership ended in July 2024. Stockal uses US-based brokers like DriveWealth for trade execution and custody. Indian investors are rushing to own Apple, Nvidia and Tesla.
